	SFA_board_orders = {
		# step 6 (plan 7.2): the state popup, a child of the board over its right column. Live, with no dirty variable:
		# political power, costs and cooldowns are always current. Every patron, Burgundy included (user, 2026-10-18).
		context_type = player_context
		parent_window_name = "SFA_board_window"
		window_name = "SFA_board_popup"

		visible = {
			has_global_flag = SFA_active
			has_country_flag = SFA_board_open
			has_country_flag = SFA_order_open
			has_country_flag = SFA_state_selected
		}

		effects = {
			SFA_popup_close_click = { SFA_board_popup_close = yes }
			SFA_popup_order_click = {
				var:SFA_selected_state = { save_event_target_as = SFA_order_target_state }
				SFA_give_order = yes
			}
			SFA_popup_improve_click = {
				var:SFA_selected_state = { save_event_target_as = SFA_supply_target }
				SFA_improve_supply = yes
				SFA_gui_refresh = yes
			}
			SFA_popup_drop_click = {
				var:SFA_selected_state = { save_event_target_as = SFA_drop_target }
				SFA_supply_drop = yes
				SFA_gui_refresh = yes
			}
		}

		triggers = {
			SFA_popup_order_click_enabled = { SFA_popup_can_order = yes }
			SFA_popup_improve_click_enabled = { SFA_popup_can_improve = yes }
			SFA_popup_drop_click_enabled = { SFA_popup_can_drop = yes }
		}

		ai_enabled = { always = no }
	}

	SFA_board_covert = {
		# step 7 (plan 4.8): Burgundy's covert actions, a live, Burgundy-only child of the board above the popup. State
		# actions hit the selected state, nation actions its holder. Paid in its global plans' supplies (BRG_supplies);
		# no debuff hits the same nation again before it runs out (the SFA_can_* triggers; user, 2026-10-18).
		context_type = player_context
		parent_window_name = "SFA_board_window"
		window_name = "SFA_board_covert"

		visible = {
			tag = BRG
			has_global_flag = SFA_active
			has_country_flag = SFA_board_open
			has_country_flag = SFA_order_open
			has_country_flag = SFA_state_selected
		}

		effects = {
			SFA_cov_supply_click = {
				var:SFA_selected_state = { SFA_brg_sabotage_supply = yes }
				SFA_gui_refresh = yes
			}
			SFA_cov_mines_click = {
				var:SFA_selected_state = { SFA_brg_wreck_mines = yes }
				SFA_gui_refresh = yes
			}
			SFA_cov_construction_click = {
				var:SFA_selected_state = { SFA_brg_sabotage_construction = yes }
				SFA_gui_refresh = yes
			}
			SFA_cov_pathogens_click = {
				var:SFA_selected_state = { SFA_brg_deploy_pathogens = yes }
				SFA_gui_refresh = yes
			}
			SFA_cov_terror_click = {
				var:SFA_selected_state = { OWNER = { SFA_brg_terrorize_population = yes } }
				SFA_gui_refresh = yes
			}
			SFA_cov_bribe_click = {
				var:SFA_selected_state = { OWNER = { SFA_brg_bribe_officers = yes } }
				SFA_gui_refresh = yes
			}
			SFA_cov_ss_click = {
				var:SFA_selected_state = { OWNER = { SFA_brg_increase_ss_presence = yes } }
				SFA_gui_refresh = yes
			}
		}

		triggers = {
			SFA_cov_supply_click_enabled = {
				check_variable = { BRG_supplies > 0 }
				var:SFA_selected_state = { SFA_can_sabotage_supply = yes }
			}
			SFA_cov_mines_click_enabled = {
				check_variable = { BRG_supplies > 0 }
				var:SFA_selected_state = { SFA_can_wreck_mines = yes }
			}
			SFA_cov_construction_click_enabled = {
				check_variable = { BRG_supplies > 0 }
				var:SFA_selected_state = { SFA_can_sabotage_construction = yes }
			}
			SFA_cov_pathogens_click_enabled = {
				check_variable = { BRG_supplies > 1 }
				var:SFA_selected_state = { SFA_can_deploy_pathogens = yes }
			}
			SFA_cov_terror_click_enabled = {
				check_variable = { BRG_supplies > 1 }
				var:SFA_selected_state = { OWNER = { SFA_can_terrorize_population = yes } }
			}
			SFA_cov_bribe_click_enabled = {
				check_variable = { BRG_supplies > 1 }
				var:SFA_selected_state = { OWNER = { SFA_can_bribe_officers = yes } }
			}
			SFA_cov_ss_click_enabled = {
				check_variable = { BRG_supplies > 3 }
				var:SFA_selected_state = { OWNER = { SFA_can_increase_ss_presence = yes } }
			}
		}

		ai_enabled = { always = no }
	}
}
